write_contracts.description: Write contracts for Kernel modification. Only SUPRA-Builder is authorized to write; all other agents are STRICTLY READ ONLY.

single_writer_rule.reason: Single Writer Rule ensures data integrity and prevents unauthorized mutations. All other agents may ONLY read.

all_agents.route: If write required, route to SUPRA-Builder via opencode

privileged_agents.error: READ ONLY - No write permissions even for privileged agents
privileged_agents.note: Single Writer Rule overrides all other permissions

validation_requirements.before_write: Proof required for all write operations
validation_requirements.audit_trail: All writes logged with agent identity, timestamp, SHA-256

security.write_authentication: JWT via opencode-zen with agent role validation
security.authorization: strict RBAC based on agent registry, with single override for SUPRA-Builder
security.audit_log: memory/audit_trail.jsonl - append-only record of ALL writes with full context

integrity.lineage_tracking: each write must reference source decision/evidence
integrity.rollback_capability: only possible via explicit human-gate decision

versioning.lock_contention: Register is lock-free append-only for reads, with Write Lock for SUPRA-Builder
versioning.conflict_resolution: Linear append (no overwrite), changes create new version entries

non_builder_write.detection: any write attempt by non-SUPRA-Builder is an immediate BLOCK
non_builder_write.action: BLOCK operation, route to Builder, log violation
non_builder_write.consequence: Agent access may be suspended until proof of compliance

proof_required_for: ANY mutation of kernel register data

builder_oversight.review_required: All builder writes require post-facto architectural review
builder_oversight.approval_needed: Writes impacting constitution or governance require Executive approval
